concerns.text: Phase 8 ‘Contract Validation’ is not linked to any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec. The spec does not mandate a separate contract‑validation step, so this plan element appears to be over‑reach.

Phase 9 ‘Quickstart Generation’ is also not referenced by any FR or SC in the spec. While a quick‑start guide is useful, it is not a required deliverable per the specification, making this an unanchored plan element.
